note: What this pack gives away about its own answer key, recorded so it cannot quietly get worse. A correct D in any four-option question, or the longest option becoming the correct one more often than this, fails the gate in content/answer-tells.mjs. These numbers are not a target: closing a line means editing questions, and 46 of these carry a human verdict bound to the text as it stands, so the leak is held level here and stopped where the options are presented to a learner instead.
